name: MITF-M melanocyte program for melanin pigmentation
rationale: All members concern melanocyte MITF-M-driven biology (pigmentation, melanocyte growth/differentiation, light response); unlike the MITF-M confusables it carries melanin synthesis, pigment granule localization and the pigment-related light responses rather than DNA repair, cell cycle or MITF-M self-regulation.

name: Salt and water homeostasis via cation-chloride cotransporters
rationale: Members cover ion and osmotic homeostasis (Na/K/Cl/Mg handling, hyper/hypotonic and salt-stress responses) anchored on SLC12 cotransporter disorders; confusables lack the osmotic/salt-stress arm or instead emphasize aldosterone/blood pressure, Na/H exchangers or K2P channels.

name: Membrane protein biogenesis in the early secretory pathway
rationale: Members span SRP/tail-anchored/multi-pass insertion into the ER membrane through COPII cargo loading and ER-to-Golgi transport; confusables lack COPII export or are dominated by ER folding quality control, ERAD and COPI retrograde traffic.

name: Sarcoplasmic reticulum calcium store regulation via SERCA uptake
rationale: All members regulate ER/SR calcium release, sequestration and cytosolic calcium lowering; the ATPase-coupled SR calcium import members distinguish it from confusables focused on calcium release or on cardiac contraction and heart rate.

name: Transcriptional control of erythroid differentiation
rationale: Members describe erythrocyte differentiation and its transcriptional programs (TAL1-GFI1B, late erythroid modules, stress-responsive ATF transcription); confusables instead emphasize stem/progenitor hematopoiesis or the megakaryocyte-platelet branch.

name: Urea cycle citrulline synthesis by ornithine transcarbamylase
rationale: All members center on the OTC step converting ornithine to citrulline within the urea cycle and arginine synthesis, including OTC deficiency; confusables cover other urea-cycle enzyme defects or ornithine/ammonium metabolism without OTC.

name: Antimicrobial protein defense against Gram-positive bacteria and fungi
rationale: Members describe effector killing of microbes (metal sequestration, cytolysis, antifungal humoral and neutrophil cytotoxicity); confusables instead emphasize neutrophil degranulation, mucosal agglutination or respiratory burst against Gram-negative bacteria.

name: Glucose acquisition and storage, intestinal absorption to glycogen
rationale: Members cover dietary carbohydrate digestion and hexose transport plus glycogen synthesis, breakdown and storage diseases; confusables carry only one arm, either glycolysis/gluconeogenesis with glycogen or hexose/urate/galactose transport without glycogen.

name: TGF-beta superfamily SMAD signaling with RUNX3 tumour-suppressor output
rationale: Members are TGF-beta/BMP/activin/AMH receptor-SMAD signaling, its regulators and cancer mutants; the RUNX3 target-gene members separate it from the nearest SMAD confusable, while RUNX3-only and BTM confusables lack the receptor-SMAD core.

core: T and B cell antigen-receptor signaling
name: T and B cell antigen-receptor signaling under co-receptor control
rationale: Members are TCR and BCR proximal signaling tuned by CD28 costimulation and CTLA4/BTLA/CD22/PECAM1 co-inhibition; the T cell confusables lack the BCR arm and the closest confusable lacks the co-inhibitory PECAM1 and antigen-presentation members.

name: Solute carrier transport dominated by neutral amino acids
rationale: Members are plasma-membrane SLC transport of amino acids, peptides, urate and sugars with their aminoacidurias; the amino acid and peptide carriers distinguish it from confusables centred on cationic amino acids, organic cations or hexoses.

name: Vascular growth and remodeling across endothelium and smooth muscle
rationale: Members span VEGF/Tie2-driven angiogenesis and endothelial behavior together with vascular smooth muscle proliferation, migration and phenotypic switching; the closest confusable lacks the smooth muscle arm and others lack the VEGF/endothelial arm.

name: Amino acid metabolism with tyrosine catabolism
rationale: Members are amino acid synthesis and breakdown (proline, glycine, glyoxylate, aromatic amino acids); tyrosine/phenylalanine catabolism separates it from threonine/organic-acid confusables, and proline/glycine metabolism from the phenylalanine/PKU one.

name: Osteoblast differentiation from mesenchymal progenitors
rationale: Members regulate mesenchymal stem cell and osteoblast proliferation/differentiation via RUNX2, Wnt, BMP and mechanical load; confusables instead center on collagen/tendon matrix, mineralization, chondrocytes or osteoclasts.

name: B cell development and activation via BCR signaling
rationale: Members describe B cell development, homeostasis and proliferation with BCR signal transduction (BTK, RAS, CD22) and its brakes; confusables lack the BCR signaling pathways and emphasize plasma cell, germinal centre or T follicular helper biology.

core: MECP2 chromatin control of neuronal gene expression
name: MECP2 chromatin control of neuronal gene expression
rationale: Members center on MECP2 regulation of neuronal genes, its Rett-type loss-of-function variants and histone deacetylation, with associated sensory phenotypes; confusables lack MECP2 or are dominated by locomotor, vocal and social behavior terms.

name: RNA polymerase II transcription control, initiation through termination
rationale: Members regulate Pol II preinitiation, elongation, poly(A)-coupled termination and R-loop resolution; confusables either cover elongation/pausing only, broad Pol I/III and RNA processing, or MYC/chromatin programs.

name: Striated muscle calcium cycling favouring cardiac relaxation
rationale: Members regulate SR calcium release and cytosolic calcium lowering in heart and skeletal muscle with negative heart rate and contraction terms; the nearest confusable carries positive regulation of contraction and heart rate instead.

name: p53 transcriptional induction of apoptosis via PUMA and NOXA
rationale: Members are p53-driven transcription of apoptotic genes and BH3-only PUMA/NOXA action on mitochondria; confusables lack either the p53 transcription arm (BAX/BAK/BAD) or the BH3-only mitochondrial step.

name: Ovarian cycle from follicle growth to luteolysis
rationale: Members span follicle growth, oocyte maturation, ovulation, luteinization, luteolysis and the estrous cycle; confusables emphasize gonadotropin hormone responses or include male Sertoli biology and lack the luteal/estrous terms.

core: Amino acid uptake across plasma membrane
name: Neutral and acidic amino acid uptake across plasma membrane
rationale: Members are plasma-membrane amino acid transport (SLC6A19 Hartnup, SLC6A14, SLC1A1, proton-coupled carriers); SLC1A1 dicarboxylic and SLC6A14 members separate it from iminoglycine/peptide confusables and Hartnup/tryptophan from the other.

name: Centrosome and astral microtubule positioning for spindle orientation
rationale: Members concern centrosome localization, MTOC microtubule anchoring/nucleation and astral microtubules orienting the spindle in asymmetric division; confusables lack spindle orientation and instead carry mitotic centrosome recruitment, cytokinesis rings or centriole duplication.

name: Plasma membrane protein delivery via endocytic recycling
rationale: Members regulate endosome-to-plasma-membrane recycling, receptor recycling and constitutive secretion; confusables center on Golgi-endosome-lysosome and retrograde traffic or Rab/ARF signaling.

name: Cardiac muscle growth and adaptation with enhanced contractility
rationale: Members regulate cardiomyocyte proliferation, hypertrophy, regeneration and sarcomere organization plus positive contraction, force and heart rate; the nearest confusable lacks the contractility terms and others are vascular smooth muscle themes.

name: Golgi architecture dynamics with membrane tubulation
rationale: Members cover Golgi disassembly/reassembly, ribbon formation, positioning and vesicle budding plus membrane tubulation; confusables lack tubulation (COPI/secretory) or lack Golgi structural reorganization.

name: Base excision repair with direct alkylation reversal
rationale: Members are DNA glycosylase/AP-site base excision repair and its defects plus ALKBH/MGMT direct alkylation reversal; confusables lack the direct reversal arm or the long-patch gap-filling and add mismatch or crosslink repair.

name: Rho GTPase cycling of RHO and CDC42 subfamilies
rationale: Members are GTPase cycles of RHOA/B/C/D and CDC42/RHOG/RHOJ with formin effectors; confusables add RAC, RND or RHOU/V cycles and lack RHOA-C or RHOG.

name: Hepatic bilirubin clearance after heme degradation
rationale: Members cover heme/tetrapyrrole breakdown and bilirubin uptake (SLCO1B1/1B3), glucuronidation (UGT1A1/1A4) and export (ABCC2) with hyperbilirubinemias; confusables are drug ADME and xenobiotic transport themes.

name: Renal proline-glycine reabsorption defects causing iminoglycinuria
rationale: All three members are SLC6A20/SLC36A2 variants causing iminoglycinuria and hyperglycinuria; confusables cover other amino acid, sugar or urate transport.

name: Motor coordination with cerebellar cortex development
rationale: Members concern locomotion, righting, proprioception and motor learning with cerebellar layer and striatal development; confusables add vocal, auditory and social behavior and lack cerebellar granular layer formation and motor learning.
